original_test_intent: Validate the complete SMBIOS Type 38 IPMI Device Information record and its encoded host-interface/address/interrupt semantics against the approved platform recipe and prove persistence across reboot.
original_method: Preserve logs, collect complete raw and decoded Type 38 on the same verified SUT, compare every field and encoded modifier/interrupt byte to the owner matrix, execute one authorized reboot, then repeat without changing IPMI configuration.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the Type 38 interface/address/encoding matrix and approves the reboot; an operator supervises workload safety and recovery while comparison remains read-only.
required_inputs: Exact SUT, BIOS/SMBIOS, BMC/IPMI firmware and dmidecode identities
Expected Type 38 record count and Interface Type/IPMI Specification Revision
Expected I2C target, NV storage and base addresses with representation rules
Base-address modifier, interrupt-info and raw BYTE bitfield semantics
Approved reboot, boot deadline, workload window and independent recovery
safety_requirements: Preserve dmesg, syslog and SEL; no log clearing
Keep SMBIOS and IPMI collection read-only; do not change BMC/IPMI interface configuration
Use protected credentials and verified host identity
Retain raw bytes so decoded address/modifier/interrupt values remain auditable
Require reboot approval and stop on wrong target, recovery failure or unexpected interface drift
No automatic retry or address inference
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, owner matrix, parser and reboot approval
Collect complete raw Type 38 and decode every address/bitfield
Compare expected and pre/post records with same-target proof
Optionally collect read-only interface corroboration without treating it as table evidence
Make no IPMI/firmware mutation, retry or PASS/FAIL verdict
engineer_actions: Approve Type 38 address/bitfield expectations and redaction policy
Review any record, address, revision or persistence deviation and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `dmidecode -t 38` is correct, but `grep -A1` omits the declared fields, does not preserve raw bitfield evidence or compare reboot persistence, and the SSH options are insecure.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely capture complete `dmidecode -t 38` stdout/stderr and raw table evidence before/after one approved reboot, then decode all interface, address, modifier and interrupt fields.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All seven named Type 38 field groups, reboot persistence, source script and 5/5-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: PACKAGE-GATED COMPLETE TYPE 38 BITFIELD AND REBOOT VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Hash raw captures, parse each Type 38 structure including base-address modifier/interrupt bits, compare the exact owner matrix and confirm identical allowed fields after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Implements complete field and bit-level validation without filtered output, log clearing or IPMI configuration changes.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A header snippet or working IPMI command cannot prove that SMBIOS advertises the correct interface type, revision, address representation or interrupt details.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Interface address meanings depend on interface type and platform implementation; they cannot be judged from numeric plausibility without the approved recipe.

project_override_considerations: Interface-specific absent/unknown address fields or interrupt modes must be allowlisted by exact platform/firmware revision and remain visible in raw/decoded evidence.
expected_evidence: Verified SUT/BIOS/SMBIOS/BMC/dmidecode identity and approved Type 38 matrix
Complete pre-reboot raw/decoded Interface Type, revision, addresses, base modifier/interrupt and BYTE
Approved reboot/boot timeline and same-target proof
Complete post-reboot capture and field/bit persistence diff
Preserved logs, no IPMI config/log write, secure-access/no-auto-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently target complete Type 38 correctness and reboot persistence. The DeepSeek filter is incomplete but does not introduce a competing source intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The Type 38 matrix and reboot approval are normal package/user inputs; they gate execution but not static review.

review_improvement: Preserves every Type 38 field while adding raw bitfield auditability, secure transport and explicit separation between advertised metadata and runtime IPMI reachability.
independent_technical_reasoning: A base address is not meaningful without its interface type and modifier bits: the same printed number can represent different address spaces or interrupt behavior. Runtime IPMI success may use another transport and therefore cannot prove SMBIOS Type 38 is encoded correctly. Complete raw/decode comparison across reboot is required, with no BMC setting changes that could alter the evidence under test.
